messages:
kevin: Heads-up — I exported an RI / SavingsPlan utilization snapshot for the GPU fleet. Us-west-2 looks concerning: ~42% effective utilization this billing month across g5 pools. Posting snapshot + quick questions.

anya: link to the dashboard?

kevin: https://redwood.app/costs/usage?range=30d&filter=us-west-2
Also exported CSV to /shared/infra/costs/ri-usage-may.csv (billing-bot uploaded)

billing-bot: CSV available: s3://redwood-costs/ri-usage-may.csv :file_folder:

marta: 42% is pretty low. Which instance SKUs are driving this? standard vs convertible RIs?

kevin: Mostly g5.2x standard RIs and a chunk of g5.8x convertible. Savings Plan coverage for GPUs is minimal right now.

ben: Could be tag drift — dev clusters accidentally on reserved capacity. Any untagged hours?

marta: We need a tag-by-team breakdown. Can you run a quick query and drop the results here?

kevin: Running now. Will share table in ~30m. Query I'm using: 
```sql
SELECT coalesce(team,'unassigned') AS team, instance_type, SUM(used_hours) AS hours, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM billing.gpu_hourly
WHERE region = 'us-west-2' AND month = '2025-05'
GROUP BY team, instance_type
ORDER BY hours DESC;
```

kevin: Raw export uploaded to the shared CSV path. Preliminary: dev-units ~18% of reserved hours, data-platform ~34%, inference-prod ~48% (but inference-prod has high idle spikes overnight).

finance-ops: From a finance POV: if utilization <60% for a SKU family we should NOT auto-renew standard RIs. Convertible RIs can be rebalanced or sold/modified, but savings plans for GPUs are tricky — coverage vs flexibility tradeoff. Need 90 & 180 day forecast before decision.

anya: For dev/test we can move to spot or pooled autoscale. If we free up standard RIs we can reduce committed spend next term.

marta: Proposal: 1) tag breakdown + list of untagged hosts (kevin) 2) migration plan for dev to spot (ben) 3) 90/180d utilization forecast (finance-ops) 4) decision meeting May 26 to approve renewals/convert.

ben: I can prototype a Migration Runbook to move dev clusters to spot + fallback policy to on-demand. ETA 1 week.

kevin: I'll add a dashboard tile showing: SKU utilization %, tag distribution, and hours eligible for re-assignment. Will also attach CSV in the meeting deck.

marta: One more question — do we have Convertible RI modification window options for the g5.8x? If yes, we might reassign sizes between teams rather than full renewal.

finance-ops: There is a mod window in June for some convertible purchases from last year. We'll check contract dates and include in the decision doc.

kevin: Action items captured. I'll push a short thread summary to the #finance channel and link the meeting invite. :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks — sounds good.

marta: Great. Thanks everyone.

kevin: CSV + dashboard links posted. Will follow up if utilization shifts in next billing cycle.
